target: AArch64 PCI QEMU using UTM-bundled QEMU/HVF, one vCPU, 1 GiB guest RAM, disposable COW disk
command: QEMU=build/utm-qemu-probe/qemu-probe QEMU_VIRT='-L /Applications/UTM.app/Contents/Resources/qemu -machine virt,accel=hvf,gic-version=3 -cpu host -smp 1 -m 1024 -device virtio-ramfb -device virtio-keyboard-device -device virtio-tablet-device' ZEAL_COMPAT_LOG_PATH=build/check-tosmisc-memtest-fixed.log python3 -u scripts/check-compat.py --pci --quick --probe-demo-system-context --demo-system-path /Demo/AcctExample/TOS/TOSMisc.ZC --demo-system-module /Demo/AcctExample/TOS/TOSConfig.ZC --demo-system-module /System/Gr/ScreenCast.ZC --demo-system-module /Apps/Psalmody/JukePuppet.ZC --demo-system-module /System/BlkDev/DiskCheck.ZC --demo-system-module /Demo/AcctExample/TOS/TOSMisc.ZC
result: pass for stock MemTest data-heap and code-heap stress loops and compiler recovery
verified: The data-heap loop allocated and filled 1 MiB blocks until the reported remaining pool crossed the stock 16 MiB threshold.
The code-heap loop independently allocated and filled 1 MiB blocks until its remaining pool crossed the stock 16 MiB threshold.
MemTest returned and printed the explicit tosmisc-memtest-done marker; the following stock TOSMisc source compilation passed.
All preceding non-destructive TOSConfig, OCR, AU-write/readback, GR-to-MV, and ScreenCast checks also passed in this run.
not_verified: TOSMisc destructive disk-formatting, repair, installer, and configured-drive workflows.
Audible output or interactive behavior on physical Pi or UTM GUI.
scope_note: The previous partial run revealed that the synthetic root task exposed a zero-initialized per-fiber code heap. The root now points to the shared code arena, while child fibers keep separate code-heap controls. This run used only a disposable COW guest disk; no user media was modified.
